For an entity that collects zakat, holding over 117.3 months of working capital represents an unusually large accumulation of undistributed capital. While <cite id="3">FY2023 financial filings reported $4,092,615 in total revenue</cite>, revenue subsequently <cite id="3">declined 10% to $3,697,122 in FY2024</cite>.
